keyframes.name: The Mire-Tomb of Mor-Ghul
keyframes.description: A half-submerged necropolis amidst the stagnant oxbows of the Drowned Clearings, where witch-fires dance over moss-choked sarcophagi and primeval spirits whisper.

host_region.name: The Drowned Clearings
host_region.lore: A tangled web of oxbow lakes, glassy freshwater sheets, and reed-choked marshes where water-lilies bear the weight of nesting herons.

neighborhood_regions.name: The Greenwood Vault
neighborhood_regions.lore: An unbroken canopy of moss-cloaked hemlocks and broad oaks, newly pierced along the Silver Channel by mortal woodcutters and the tilled crofts of Aethelford.

keyframes.name: The Mire-Tomb of Mor-Ghul

host_region.name: The Drowned Clearings
host_region.lore: A haunted wilderness of stagnant oxbow lakes and reed marshes where witch-fires burn brighter since mortal axes approached from the north, its drowned crypts whispering with restless malevolence.

neighborhood_regions.name: The Greenwood Vault
neighborhood_regions.lore: An ancient expanse of moss-cloaked hemlocks and colossal oaks, now cleaved by the Silver Span and the corduroy logs of the Sylvan Trace as woodcutters push their fortified frontier into the eastern gloom.

keyframes.name: The Necropolis of Mor-Ghul
keyframes.description: The shattered cyclopean gates have burst, unsealing the submerged necropolis beneath the oxbows. Ancient wight-lords and risen drowned legions now stir within its obsidian vaults, projecting a chilling death-fog across the scarred forest.
keyframe_triggers: name_mutation ('The Mire-Tomb of Mor-Ghul' -> 'The Necropolis of Mor-Ghul')

host_region.name: The Blighted Mire
host_region.lore: A petrified desolation of necrotic ash and calcified roots, where the shattered wards of Mor-Ghul bleed ancient malevolence into the withered fens, choking the waterways with poisoned silt and unhallowed spirits.

neighborhood_regions.name: The Drowned Clearings
neighborhood_regions.lore: A forsaken expanse of stagnant oxbows where the water runs black with necromantic ash, unhallowed corpse-candles burn in perpetual fog, and restless spirits wail beneath weeping willows draped in calcified rot.
